item.description: AI Minister Niamh Smyth says X has assured her that the AI tool that allows for editing of intimate images on Grok will be disabled here in Ireland. The platform says it's now geo-blocking users from creating images of people in bikinis or underwear worldwide. The Cavan-Monaghan Minister met with X today, after receiving legal advice from the Attorney General yesterday. item.description: There have been calls for renewed impetus for the development of enterprise centres across the Northern Sound region.
